description_excerpt: Your responsibilities • Assist our customers by providing technical and business assistance on our product. • Diagnose and reproduce issues reported by customers, and when possible, propose a solution or workaround. If no solution can be found, document the issue and escalate it to the engineering team (Level 3). • Ensure issues are resolved within the agreed Service-Level Agreement (“SLA”) and follow the escalation process in case of deviation.
